title: Bringing Characters to Life — Understanding Round, Flat, Static and Dynamic Characters in Stories
skills: distinguish among round, flat, static, and dynamic characters
identify evidence of character complexity and change
analyze how character type contributes to narrative development and meaning
alignment_note: Provides a comparative overview of four common character classifications: round, flat, static, and dynamic. Supports characterization, close reading, character-change analysis, textual evidence, and narrative interpretation across high school English courses.
